public class ImmunizationState extends org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Composition
This class is a subclass of Composition. Therefore it defines the structure and narrative content necessary for an immmunization state.
There are functionalities to generate CDA document elements of Composition resource.

      public static org.husky.cda.elga.generated.artdecor.AtcdabbrHeaderDocumentationOfServiceEventEImpfpass getAtcdabbrHeaderDocumentationOfServiceEvent(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Composition composition)
      Generates service event for immunization states with information of passed Composition.
      Code of service event is always set to {@link ElgaEventCodeList.<code>IMMUNIZATION_RECORD</code>} (41000179103 - Immunization record (record artifact)). Period of health service event is extracted from passed Composition.
      Parameters:
      composition - with information about service event.
      Returns:
      created service event for immunization states. AtcdabbrHeaderDocumentationOfServiceEventEImpfpass

    • getAtcdabbrHeaderDocumentReplacementRelatedDocument

      Generates related documents for immunization states with information of passed Composition.
      Code of service event is always set to Identifier of related document is extracted from passed Composition. Type of relationship is always set to RPLC (replaces).

    • getHl7CdaR2Pocdmt000040StructuredBodyImmunizationState

      public static org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.POCDMT000040StructuredBody getHl7CdaR2Pocdmt000040StructuredBodyImmunizationState(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Composition composition, Map<org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Immunization,org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.PractitionerRole> immunizations)
      Generates structured body for immunization states with information of passed immunizations.
      This method adds immunization section to structured body. All other sections are currently not supported. Passed immunizations are added to created section as entries.
      Parameters:
      composition - to add sections
      immunizations - map of immunizations and their author
      Returns:
      created POCDMT000040StructuredBody for immunization states.
